rows.title: New Build Duplex – Full Electrical
rows.desc: Complete electrical fit-out of the new-build duplex (both units): prewire of both units, mains and switchboards, earthing, fibre/data, downlights, socket outlets, switches, aerial, and heat-pump supply and fit-off (indoor and outdoor units). Boards labelled, lockout tags and photos completed. Tested. (Utility connection/metering being coordinated separately with the network — liven LH unit before owner takeover.)

rows.title: Additional Works – Workshop/Office Fit-out
rows.desc: Range of additional works across the workshop and office: installed new socket outlets in the office and workshop (incl. suspended ceiling outlet for workstation and weatherproof outlet in compressor room), installed exhaust/extractor fans in the bathroom and soldering room with power feeds and roof penetrations, installed a 180° driveway sensor operating a twin-spot at the back door on an auto/manual switch, installed exterior lighting at the rear roller door and workshop driveway, and installed a wireless entry alarm with warehouse speaker. Tested — all OK.
rows.site: 653 Main Street, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: Rural Mains & Meter Board Reinstatement
rows.desc: Attended after meter board fell off / no power to shed. Temporary make-safe on first visit. Ran 16mm 3-core NS mains from the power pole to the shed, shed to woolshed, and shed toward the house mains, into the meter board (stripped and Raychem terminated). Installed new Voltex 12-way surface switchboard under the woolshed, fitted lighting (5ft LED battens) and HWC circuits, installed earth stakes, met the network linesman, transferred meters to the new board and issued certification. Repaired a TPS cable damaged during trenching.

rows.title: Deodoriser System – VSD Replacement
rows.desc: Attended deodoriser system fault; diagnosed the VSD as faulty. Sourced a scarce replacement ABB drive (only two in NZ) and prepared a temporary contactor/relay control to keep the system running if delayed. Installed and commissioned the new VSD; when the pressure-transmitter speed reference wasn't valid, reconfigured the drive to start/stop on the push-button circuit. Return visit: found the analogue input needed a 0V ground, rescaled the AI (4mA=0Hz, 20mA=50Hz) and confirmed the pump now runs correctly from the pressure transmitter.
rows.site: 83 Lombard Street, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: Heat Pump Install (7.8kW)
rows.desc: Supplied and installed a new 7.8kW Gree Kingfisher high-wall heat pump in the lounge to manufacturer specification. Evacuated refrigeration pipework to required vacuum before commissioning. Connected electrical supply by teeing into the existing lounge power circuit, and supplied/installed a new isolator and conduit. Tested and commissioned — all tests passed.
rows.site: 22 Snowdon Avenue, Terrace End, Palmerston North

rows.title: Power Connection – Septic Tank
rows.desc: Scoped and completed a new power connection for the replacement septic tank: ran new 2.5mm 2C+E from the switchboard on a 16A breaker, installed 25mm conduit through the external wall with junction box, ran cable to the pump and control wiring for the indoor controller. Completed continuity, insulation-resistance and RCD testing. Pump and controller operate correctly; the high-level alarm strobe stayed on due to an indoor-controller jumper/config — advised the tank supplier's service technician to inspect further. Wiring completed strictly to manufacturer instructions.

rows.title: Heat Pump Louvre Fault (Warranty)
rows.desc: Multiple attendances to diagnose the Mitsubishi heat pump louvre fault (lower vane only moving 2 of 5 positions). Replaced the louvre stepper motor, then the indoor PCB/mainboard — fault persisted. Pattons/BDT and the Mitsubishi rep now confirming whether this is normal operation for the unit. ⚠ Warranty job — confirm who is invoiced (Pattons/warranty vs customer) before sending.
rows.site: 52 Geneva Terrace, Kelvin Grove, Palmerston North

rows.title: Conduit & Cable for Services
rows.desc: Ran conduit and 2.5mm TPS cable to the septic tank and water tank, ran 1mm draw wire in conduit, ran 16mm NS mains for solar, and bonded the house. Materials: conduit, bends and cable.

rows.title: Diesel Tank Power Relocation
rows.desc: Disconnected the Everlink and AdBlue/diesel station at the old site, scoped the new site, then supplied and installed power to the diesel fuel tank and sensor light, and rewired the Everlink and AdBlue tank to the control panel at the new location.

rows.title: Single-Phase Pump & Auto/Manual Switch
rows.desc: Ran a new supply cable under the house to the sump pump and installed a new 20A MCB and weatherproof switch. Installed Betaflex around the dispatching plant and ran a new feed from the control panel back to the shed, installed a new double switch and control for a new shed light (conduit and cable), and wired in an auto/manual switch for the flood light. Tested — all OK.

rows.title: New Rural Power Connection
rows.desc: Installed the switchboard and mains for the new rural power connection: ran 8m 16mm 3-core NS mains, installed the earth stake and board, fitted missing terminal screws and applied lockout tag on the main switch. Return visit for final testing — pulled the paddock feed and completed EFL / earth-continuity / insulation testing (all satisfactory). Coordinated the new connection (ICP/retailer) with the network and retailer.

rows.title: Various Jobs
rows.desc: Fixed deck lights (required reconnection), replaced the 15A weatherproof outlet for the spa pool, replaced the garage-entry flood light, and ran a new outlet circuit for the garden water feature switched by a weatherproof switch. Tested.

rows.title: Temperature Monitoring on RO (Goodman Fielder)
rows.desc: Ran the IFM temperature-probe cable into the container and back to the control panel, terminated onto a spare analogue input, and installed. Ordered labels and coordinated the analogue-input details with the controls integrator.

rows.title: Move BTS / Switchboard
rows.desc: Took down the temporary builder's board, dug the trench across to the house, installed the new 40-way switchboard, ran and fitted off the mains cable, backfilled the trench, and installed 2 temporary weatherproof power outlets for the builder. Tested.
rows.site: 1034 roberts line Lot 2 Roberts Line North, Bunnythorpe

rows.title: Pump Controls & Timer
rows.desc: Investigated high power usage and pump faults. Adjusted a mis-set circulation-pump float switch; found the second pump's low-level float switch failed (water ingress) and temporarily wired the high-level float to keep the pump running. Return visit: sourced the correct on-time/off-delay relay, fitted a new Voltex switch, wired in the time-delay relay, connected both pumps, the float switch and the two high-level alarms — system tested and operating correctly. (Float switch / control panel replacement recommended — supplier to quote.)

rows.title: Broadway Redevelopment – Lighting
rows.desc: Replaced 22 blown fluorescent tubes at the old premises and replaced one complete fitting with an LED panel light (drivers had failed). Tested.
rows.site: 219 Broadway Avenue, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: Broadway Redevelopment – PIR & Desk
rows.desc: Fitted PIR sensors to three bathroom light switches and removed the reception-counter socket outlet so the desk could be cut down.
rows.site: 219 Broadway Avenue, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: Meter Board & Mains Reconfiguration
rows.desc: Complete reconfiguration of the main supply: rerouted the mains from the meter board to the internal switchboard, installed a new main switch and ran new cabling from the main switch to the meter and back to the internal main switch for a safe, compliant supply. Identified and removed an unauthorised power connection, diagnosed and repaired faults on the red and blue phases, and rebalanced all final subcircuits evenly across the phases. Full testing completed — earth-stake resistance, mains insulation resistance and operational testing of all outlets, all satisfactory. Oven inspected and found to have an internal fault — replacement recommended.

rows.title: Milling Machine Cooling Fan
rows.desc: Investigated overheating milling-machine cooling fan. Dismantled the motor fan cavity and found the original 2-phase fan (driven from the motor windings) not spinning; the transformer stepped the winding to 120V so a standard fan could not run from it. Sourced and fitted a 230VAC fan, and — with no neutral in the existing supply — installed a new 5-pin 32A socket outlet and ran a separate neutral to the fan housing. Tested.

rows.title: Rewire Lights & Additional Work
rows.desc: Rewired the lighting to the hallway, two bedrooms, office and lounge. Installed a new double socket outlet in the lounge (right of the front door) and reinstated two lounge lights. (Light fittings client-supplied except the office batten holder.)

rows.title: Diesel Tank – 3-Phase Outlet
rows.desc: Fitted the new 20A 5-pin 3-phase switched socket outlet to the post beside the existing supply outlet. ⚠ Return visit required to fit the pump motor (client's fittings were incorrect and need to be made up) and to run conduit along the base of the diesel tank for cable protection. Note: control-panel wiring is currently single-phase — confirm whether it needs converting to three-phase.

rows.title: Supply of Materials
rows.desc: Supply of materials (supply only — no on-site labour recorded).

rows.title: No Hot Water (Urgent)
rows.desc: Attended urgent no-hot-water call. Drained the hot water cylinder and replaced the blown 2kW element. Tested.

rows.title: Outdoor Power Point (Insurance)
rows.desc: Installed a new outdoor caravan power outlet for the insured's camper lead. Property was without power following a previous fire, so the outlet could not be functionally tested; carried out insulation-resistance testing on the main supply cables and earth conductor — all passed. Outlet to be tested once mains power restored. (Asbestos present — appropriate PPE used.)

rows.title: Everlink Install
rows.desc: Extended power supply from the AdBlue tank to the diesel tank: isolated supply at the switchboard, ran conduit and Betaflex up the tank legs, installed a new isolation switch on the diesel tank, drilled and fitted new adapter to the pump box, ran and connected cable, fitted 6mm earth with lug and bonded to metal tank box, and connected the power and pump cables into the Everlink unit. Tested OK — insulation resistance >2000 MΩ, earth continuity 0.6 Ω.

rows.title: Power Connection for Septic Tank
rows.desc: Ran 25mm conduit and 2.5mm cable from under the house across to the new septic tank, junction-boxed the new septic cable onto the existing circuit under the floor and connected the tank. Materials included conduit, flex, junction box, cable and danger tape.

rows.title: Broadway Redevelopment – LED Panels
rows.desc: Supplied and installed two 1200x600 LED panel lights in the main office area.
rows.site: 219 Broadway Avenue, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: Switches & Outlets – Fit-off
rows.desc: Measured, drilled and fitted off 6 Voltex downlights (2 in one bedroom, 4 in another), 3 single-gang switches, 2 main switches and 1 two-way switch, plus 6 Voltex vertical double socket outlets. Livened and tested all — completed following painting.

rows.title: Switchboard Upgrade – Scoping
rows.desc: Initial scoping and client liaison for the proposed switchboard upgrade and power-factor-correction unit, including site visit and correspondence to progress the works.

rows.title: Replacement Outlets & Fittings
rows.desc: Supplied and installed 7 socket outlets at the customer's request, replaced the bathroom RCD cover plate, and replaced 8 bulbs. Tested.

rows.title: Power Connection – Septic Tank
rows.desc: New power connection for the replacement septic tank: ran a feed under the house teed into an existing circuit, ran cable to the end of the house with a new isolation switch, and ran conduit from the side of the house to the septic tank. Left isolated at the isolator ready for the tank installer to commission.

rows.title: Test & Tag – Workshop
rows.desc: Attended workshop and tested/tagged 30 items. A return visit is required to complete testing and tagging of the remaining equipment.
rows.site: 29 Kelvin Grove Road, Kelvin Grove, Palmerston North

rows.title: Replace Rangehood
rows.desc: Removed old rangehood, drilled new 150mm ducting hole, ran new cable from the mounting block across to the rangehood, and installed the new client-supplied 600mm rangehood with new 150mm duct and Manrose 150mm flap grille. Tested.

rows.title: Test & Tag + EWOF
rows.desc: Tested and tagged 35 items around the site, and arranged/attended the electrical WOF for the portacom.

rows.title: Downstairs Lights Fault
rows.desc: Investigated dead downstairs lighting circuit (burnt-out CB, suspected rodent damage). Fitted a new 10A CB and fault-traced the circuit — found open-circuit, traced toward the downstairs toilet switch; circuit needs a new feed run (return visit). Repaired the stairs light with a new angled batten holder. Reassembled switches.

rows.title: Water Ingress at Light – Make Safe
rows.desc: Attended insurance make-safe. Disconnected the affected kitchen light fitting and switch impacted by the upstairs shower leak, fitted strip connectors and isolated at the switch so the site is safe for the plumber to isolate the leak. CoC and completion photos provided.

rows.title: Office Hot Water Cylinder
rows.desc: Wired up the new heat-pump hot water cylinder: installed a new 20A resettable circuit and base at the board and a new 32A isolator at the cylinder on 6mm supply cable. Completed insulation-resistance testing — satisfactory. Installation completed and verified. (Earlier attendance not proceeded — site not ready.)

rows.title: Oven Fault & Downlights
rows.desc: Attended to diagnose oven fault. Dismantled and tested all elements (all OK). Traced 0V at the bottom bake element back to the function selector switch, which was found burnt out. ⚠ New function selector switch on order — return visit required to complete. Also assessed kitchen downlights and recommended replacement.

rows.title: Install 3 x Light Fittings
rows.desc: Removed 3 existing light fittings and fitted new cabling where existing was too short or missing. Repaired and installed all 3 fittings. (No power on site at time of visit, so lamps could not be tested.)

rows.title: Switchboard Visual Inspections
rows.desc: Carried out visual inspections of switchboards and compiled the inspection report.
rows.cust: DABS Broadway Ave LP - Palmerston Noth
rows.site: 200 Broadway Avenue, City Center, Palmerston North

rows.title: Oven Lead & Cabling Tidy
rows.desc: Fitted a new 4-pin lead to the oven at the testing station and tested (all four elements work; noted the oven itself does not power on — no light or heat — warmer drawer OK). Tidied and re-routed the lighting cabling in the conservatory.

rows.title: Mains Switch Replacement
rows.desc: Replaced burnt-out main switch (found overheating and tripping) like-for-like, and replaced the damaged busbar. Due to the board configuration, installed a 16mm² link from the main switch to the first breaker in place of the busbar. Tested on completion — correct operation confirmed.

rows.title: Bathroom Works
rows.desc: Replaced 6 flush boxes and swapped 6 old single socket outlets for 6 new Voltex vertical double socket outlets. Investigated and got the extraction fan working (client would like it moved to a separate switch). Assessed towel-rail installation. Client-supplied fittings.
rows.site: 43A Worcester Street, West End, Palmerston North

rows.title: Through-Wall Heat Transfer Fan
rows.desc: Cut a 100mm hole through from the lounge to the hallway and installed the client-supplied through-wall heat-transfer fan. Changed the single switch to a double with new mechanism, ran 1mm cable to the fan and fitted off at the hallway light switch. Tested.

rows.title: Generator Fault Investigation
rows.desc: Attended KiwiRail site to investigate generator #4138 cutting out when both sides plugged in. Checked generator operation — runs but still stops with the chillers connected. Findings reported.
rows.site: 605 Tremaine Avenue, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: Hot Water Cylinder – Reconnect
rows.desc: Return visit to reconnect the new hot water cylinder. Tested.

rows.title: HRV Filter Change
rows.desc: Supplied and installed a new high-grade F8 deep-pleat filter to the existing HRV ventilation unit (replacing the coarse-grade filter allowing fine roof-cavity dust through). Checked the filter housing seal and ceiling-cavity ducting and cleaned the ceiling diffusers. Note: some residual dust may clear over 1–2 weeks; if it persists the ducting itself needs attention (separate quote).
rows.site: 8 Snowdon Avenue, Terrace End, Palmerston North

rows.title: Fix TV Aerial
rows.desc: Attended and connected a new splitter to restore the TV aerial signal. Tested working.

rows.title: Oven Repair (Urgent)
rows.desc: Attended urgent oven fault. Inspected and tested the oven; replaced two faulty thermostats (like-for-like). Identified and corrected a wiring fault at the isolator where the neutral was in contact with the active, re-terminated and tested for safe operation. Diagnosed the rear-right outer element as faulty and requiring replacement.

rows.title: Reception Lights Repair
rows.desc: Repaired burnt-out connector blocks and junction-boxed them. Tested all reception lights OK.
rows.site: 240 Broadway Avenue, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: Oven Installation & Disposal
rows.desc: First visit: removed old oven and measured the cavity, providing gas clearance and width dimensions. Return visit: removed old oven, checked new oven rating (max 11A) against the existing 15A lead (suitable), removed obstructing brackets, fitted new lead, installed and secured the new oven. Tested — all OK.

rows.title: Heat Pump Not Working (Urgent)
rows.desc: Attended urgent heat-pump fault (unit powered and running but no air / silent fan). Investigated and diagnosed fault; findings recorded and reported.
rows.cust: Ray White | REH Property Management Ltd

rows.title: Cement Silo – Soft Starter Tripping
rows.desc: Attended Golden Bay cement silo where the soft starter was repeatedly tripping. Motor started and ran without issue on inspection; checked motor (rated 38A) and soft-starter settings (overload set to 50A — recommended review/confirmation with Golden Bay). After electrical checks found no fault, motor tripped on overload; with site assistance identified several manual valves left closed, causing excessive load and high torque tripping the overload at ~42A. Root cause operational, not electrical.

rows.title: Test & Tag
rows.desc: Tested and tagged 2 trailers and 2 trailer-loads of plant and equipment (generators and pumps). All items passed and tagged.
rows.site: 83 Lombard Street, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: Stove – Left Rear Element
rows.desc: Investigated left rear stove element not working on high. Replaced the faulty energy regulator (broken internal track). All tested and working.
rows.site: 28 Parnell Heights Drive, Kelvin Grove, Palmerston North

rows.title: Reposition Security Camera (End of Tenancy)
rows.desc: Replaced the broken dummy turret camera (sourced from wholesaler) and re-mounted it on the wall. Tested — all OK.

rows.title: Loss of Power to Rear Flat
rows.desc: Attended loss of power to the rear flat. Found and replaced the blown 32A HRC fuse in the main building switchboard. Measured flat load — drawing ~25A (HWC 13.2A, freezers, washing machine 9A while heating) which with the range elements exceeds the fuse rating. Advised the supply to the flat likely needs upgrading to prevent recurring fuse failures.
rows.site: 159 Broadway Avenue, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: Kitchen Fit-off
rows.desc: Kitchen fit-off: fitted off two kitchen socket outlets and tested all points, hardwired and secured the hob with safety latches, screwed in the oven, and tested and labelled. Hob left properly connected for the supplier's inspection (unit cracked).
rows.site: 407 Te Matai Road, Whakarongo, Palmerston North

rows.title: Exhaust Fan, Oven & Switchboard
rows.desc: Replaced an old vertical double socket outlet with a new Voltex unit, replaced the faulty oven with a new Westinghouse freestanding oven (like-for-like), and adjusted the kitchen exhaust fan to stop it squeaking. Tested.

rows.title: Replace Sensor Light
rows.desc: Replaced faulty sensor light (old sensor failed). Tested.

rows.title: Install Oven
rows.desc: Swapped the oven connection lead from the old oven to the new client-supplied oven, installed the new oven, plugged in and tested. Old oven removed for disposal.

rows.title: HWC Electrical Connection
rows.desc: Carried out the electrical connection for the new hot water cylinder (working alongside Fast Flow Plumbing). Materials: 120mm gland, 1m 1.5mm 2C+E flex cord, sundries.
rows.site: 285B Fitzherbert Avenue, West End, Palmerston North

rows.title: Heat Pump Not Working
rows.desc: Attended and assessed why the heat pump was not working — diagnosed as requiring a re-gas. Quote for re-gas to follow (discussed with the property manager). Diagnostic visit.
rows.site: 38A Bourke Street, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: Decommission Heat Pump
rows.desc: Removed and decommissioned the heat pump/AC unit from the room following the attempted break-in and smashed window, so the glazier can complete the glass repair.
rows.site: 1/97 Grey Street, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: 20A Socket – Supply Only
rows.desc: Supply of 20A socket outlet and associated materials (supply only).

rows.title: Relay Fuse
rows.desc: Attended site to investigate reported loss of power at the relay fuse / ripple controller. Diagnosed the fault, carried out repair and restored supply. All tested and left in safe working order.
rows.site: 23 McGiffert Street, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: Downlight Replacement (Warranty)
rows.desc: Return visit (first attempt client unavailable). Removed the failed downlight and installed the replacement, tested — all OK. (Downlight covered under Voltex warranty; labour chargeable.)

rows.title: Generator Fault Check
rows.desc: Attended KiwiRail site to check generator #4138. Tested the generator with a chiller unit connected and checked the load — generator operating correctly with no electrical faults or visible defects found.
rows.site: 605 Tremaine Avenue, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: Concrete Vibrator Not Working
rows.desc: Attended reported vibrator fault on the concrete chute. On inspection found the unit to be air-operated (not electrical) — air supply was present but continuously exhausting, indicating a pneumatic fault outside the electrical scope. Referred to the compressed-air service provider.

rows.title: Switchboard Visual Inspections
rows.desc: Carried out visual switchboard inspection and report compilation.
rows.cust: DABS 585 Main Street PN LP - Palmerston North
rows.site: 585 Main Street, Palmerston North Central, Palmerston North

rows.title: No Power (Fire Damage) – Attendance
rows.desc: Attended reported loss of power from suspected fire damage on the pole line. Liaised with the customer, who was arranging supply isolation with the lines company and had also contacted another contractor; customer did not confirm they required us to proceed. Attendance/call-out only.

rows.title: Heat Pump Not Heating – Diagnosis
rows.desc: Attended heat pump not heating. Indoor unit not receiving the remote; forced into cooling, then threw an F5 fault. Advised the customer the unit is best replaced and provided photos for a replacement quote. Diagnostic visit (may be credited if replacement proceeds with us).
